The '''Y-wing scout bomber''' was a variant of the [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighter]] that was developed during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|Clone trooper pilot]] [[Warthog/Legends|Warthog]] flew a prototype [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] to a [[Republic outpost (Warthog)|Republic outpost]] during the war.
